Definition: to clatter, i.e. slap (the hands together), clang (an instrument); by analogy, to drive (a nail or tent-pin, a dart, etc.); by implication, to become bondsman by handclasping)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to blow, clap, strike, sound, thrust, give a blow, blast; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to thrust, drive (of weapon); 1a2) to give a blast, give a blow; 1a3) to strike or clap hands; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be blown, blast (of horn); 1b2) to strike or pledge oneself
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
